### docs/ README (proposed)

---
title: Ultraterrestrial Documentation Hub
description: Central index, structure, and conventions for the repository’s documentation
created: 2025-08-09T00:00:00Z
lastUpdated: 2025-08-09T00:00:00Z
author: Liam Ellis
version: 1.0.0
---

## Purpose

- Centralize all high-level, cross-project documentation.
- Standardize structure, naming, and metadata across docs.
- Provide quick navigation to planning, prompts, and work logs.

## Scope

This hub documents the `docs/` folder only. App- and package-specific docs live within their respective paths (e.g., `apps/app/docs/`, `packages/ai/prometheus/docs/`).

## Directory Structure

## Conventions

- Front matter (YAML) is required for human/metadata separation:
  - `created`, `lastUpdated`: ISO 8601 UTC (e.g., 2025-08-09T00:00:00Z)
  - `author`, `version`: maintain authorship and doc version
- Human-readable dates in content use “MMMM do yyyy” (e.g., “August 9th 2025”).
- Keep docs focused, scoped, and discoverable. Prefer linking over duplication.
- File names: PascalCase for conceptual docs (e.g., `PROMPT_INVENTORY.md`), hyphenated for reports if needed.

## Adding New Documents

1. Choose location:
   - Strategic/architecture/roadmaps → `docs/PLANS/`
   - Prompt specs/inventories → `docs/PROMPTS/`

## Overview

This directory centralizes high-level project documentation. It is organized for discoverability and maintenance. App- and package-specific docs live with their code (e.g., `apps/app/docs/`, `packages/*/docs/`).

## How to Use

- Read plans in `docs/PLANS/` for architecture, PRDs, roadmaps, and fixes.
- Use `docs/PROMPTS/` for prompt inventories, schemas, and methodology.
- Record development sessions in `docs/WORK_LOGS/` (append-only).
- Navigate everything via `docs/INDEX.md`.

## Conventions

- Front matter metadata: `created`, `lastUpdated` (ISO 8601 UTC), `author`, `version`.
- Human-readable dates in content: format as “August 9th 2025”.
- Prefer links over duplication; keep documents focused.

## Adding New Documents

1. Pick the right folder:
   - Strategy/architecture/roadmaps → `PLANS/`
   - Prompt specs/inventories → `PROMPTS/`
   - Session logs/notes → `WORK_LOGS/`
2. Include front matter metadata (see above).
3. Cross-link related docs; reference app/package docs when useful.
4. Do not hand-edit `INDEX.md` (it’s regenerated from the filesystem).
